title: Texas General Price List checks (Occupations Code Ch. 651, 22 TAC Ch. 203)
scope: Texas providers only: run when the list's address is in Texas. Adds what Texas requires beyond the federal checks (ftc-453); requirements Texas shares with the federal rule are left to those checks. General Price List only.
status: draft, not legal advice; see prep/rules/tx-tfsc-sources.md

source.statute: Texas Occupations Code Ch. 651, statutes.capitol.texas.gov, current through the 89th Legislature, 2nd Called Session, 2025
source.rules: 22 TAC Part 10, Texas Secretary of State TAC viewer, query date 2026-11-26

basis_values.statute: Requirement stated in the Texas Occupations Code; the check cites the section.
basis_values.agency_rule: Requirement stated in a Texas Funeral Service Commission rule (22 TAC Part 10); the check cites the rule.

sections: Each check lists the ids of the sections of Texas law it rests on: us-tx/occ/<section> for the Occupations Code, us-tx/22tac/<rule> for 22 TAC.

N-tx-selection.t: The goods and services shown below are those we can provide to our customers. You may choose only the items you desire. However, any funeral arrangements you select will include a charge for our basic services and overhead. If legal or other requirements mean you must buy any items you did not specifically ask for, we will explain the reason in writing on the statement we provide describing the funeral goods and services you selected.

N-tx-crematory.t: The goods and services shown below are those we can provide to our customers. You may choose only the items you desire. If legal or other requirements mean you must buy any items you did not specifically ask for, we will explain the reason in writing on the statement we provide describing the goods and services you selected.

N-tx-third-party-insurance.t: Please note that if you utilize a third party to file a claim seeking expedited receipt of life insurance proceeds on behalf of a beneficiary, there will be a fee to be paid associated with the filing of such a claim.

checks.title: Life insurance claim filing priced
checks.applies_when: the list offers filing life insurance claims
checks.test: an item for filing or processing a life insurance claim shows a price, or says there is no charge
checks.plain: If the funeral home offers to file life insurance claims for the family, the list must show what it charges for that, or say there is no charge.

checks.title: Selection notice includes "basic services and overhead"
checks.applies_when: the federal selection notice is on the list
checks.test: the notice includes the sentence about a charge for basic services and overhead
checks.plain: Texas law prints the notice above the prices with the sentence "However, any funeral arrangements you select will include a charge for our basic services and overhead." The Funeral Service Commission's rule lets that sentence be shortened or left out, so a list without it is flagged for a person to decide.

checks.title: Crematory notice
checks.applies_when: the list says the provider operates a crematory
checks.test: the crematory notice, without the basic-services sentence, is on the list
checks.plain: A crematory's price list must carry its own notice. When the list says the provider runs a crematory, both notices are expected.

checks.title: Third-party insurance filing statement
checks.applies_when: the list mentions paying with life insurance and does not offer claim filing
checks.test: the statement about third-party claim filing fees is on the list
checks.plain: If the funeral home asks for payment before insurance pays out and does not file the claim itself, the list must say that a third party who files the claim will charge a fee. Whether that applies depends on the home's payment terms, so a person should check.
